title: About Tradenest Naturals
content_html:
Natural Ingredients from India, Built for Global Food Brands

Tradenest Naturals is an Indian manufacturer and exporter of natural food ingredients. We supply dehydrated vegetable powders and flakes, spray dried fruit and vegetable powders, herbal and Ayurvedic botanical powders, culinary herbs, spices and specialty seasoning powders to food manufacturers, nutraceutical and cosmetic brands, distributors and importers worldwide. Food premixes and custom blends are being added to our range.

We are an FSSAI-licensed food business and an IEC-registered exporter, and every shipment is supported with export documentation.

What We Offer International Buyers

  • 90+ ingredients across dehydrated, spray dried, herbal, superfood and spice categories
  • Low MOQ from 5 Kg for trials and new product development, scaling to FCL and LCL container supply
  • OEM & private label manufacturing and packaging for your brand
  • Custom specifications — mesh size, moisture targets and blends on request
  • Flexible packaging — 25 kg bags or HDPE containers, 5–10 kg bags and smaller private label packs
  • Samples on request so your QA team can test before a bulk order

How Every Batch Is Made

Raw material procurement → cleaning & sorting → controlled dehydration → grinding & sieving → quality inspection → packaging & dispatch. Each batch is checked before it is packed and shipped.
